description: This file defines a static class 'Dependencies' with a method 'ConfigureServices' that configures database contexts and related services based on configuration settings, specifically toggling between in-memory and SQL Server databases for the eShopWeb application.

classes.name: Dependencies
classes.description: A static class responsible for configuring dependency injection services, particularly database contexts, based on application configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures and registers database context services for the application, choosing between in-memory and SQL Server databases based on configuration settings.
